description: Upload a CSV or XLSX file and start a bulk email verification job. After success, poll email_verify_bulk_status with the returned list_id.

file.description: Base64-encoded CSV or XLSX file content.

ignore_duplicate_file.description: Allow re-uploading a file with the same name and size as a recent upload

optimize.description: Verification mode. highest_accuracy (default): extra attempts on greylisted and catch-all emails; fastest_turnaround: quicker results, fewer retries; deep_verify: resolves catch-all emails to valid/invalid, costs more and takes longer

name: email_verify_bulk_start
title: Start Bulk Email Verification
